question: top 5 customers by revenue
sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: top 5 products by revenue ?
sql:

FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: What are the individual costs and the region where each of the top 5 products ('Reactive asymmetric array', 'Seamless attitude-oriented initiative', 'Face-to-face modular monitoring', 'Triple-buffered tertiary benchmark', and 'Business-focused value-added toolset') is sold most?
sql:
WITH product_region_qty AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    c.region,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name, c.region
),
product_totals AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(total_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS product_total_quantity
  FROM product_region_qty
),
product_region_with_total AS (
  SELECT prq.*, pt.product_total_quantity
  FROM product_region_qty prq
  JOIN product_totals pt USING (product_id)
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT product_id
  FROM (
    SELECT product_id,
           product_total_quantity,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY product_total_quantity DESC) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT product_id, product_total_quantity
      FROM product_region_with_total
    ) x
  ) y
  WHERE rn <= 5
)
SELECT
  prt.product_id,
  prt.product_name,
  prt.region,
  prt.total_quantity
FROM (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS rn_region
  FROM product_region_with_total
) prt
JOIN top_products tp ON prt.product_id = tp.product_id
WHERE prt.rn_region = 1
ORDER BY prt.product_id;

question: tell the top 5 products according to their returning
sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refund
FROM returns r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_refund DESC
LIMIT 5;
